mechanics_summary: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user spins vertically and fires a freezing projectile that deals a documented 15% damage over five hits, then freezes the opponent for about 3 seconds. The current Xenoverse 2 reference classifies it as a pseudo-Strike projectile with short-to-long range; exact startup, freeze timing, and patch-independent damage scaling remain unresolved.
